How to generate a RESTful API request on Cisco Nexus Dashboard?
version:3.1.0
IP:192.168.11.33
API name: get nodes list
Parameter_fabricName:PEK-ACI

function.name: requests_get
function.description: Sends an HTTP GET request to retrieve a list of nodes associated with a specified fabric in a network. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

url.description: The URL to send the GET request to. The URL should include the target IP, API endpoint, and the fabricName query parameter placeholder https://<ip>/sedgeapi/v1/cisco-nir/api/api/telemetry/flowrules/nodes?fabricName={fabricName}.

fabricName.description: The name of the fabric whose nodes are to be listed. This value is used to replace the {fabricName} placeholder in the URL.

The URL template: https://<ip>/sedgeapi/v1/cisco-nir/api/api/telemetry/flowrules/nodes?fabricName={fabricName}. We need to replace <ip> with 192.168.11.33 and fabricName with PEK-ACI.

So the URL: https://192.168.11.33/sedgeapi/v1/cisco-nir/api/api/telemetry/flowrules/nodes?fabricName=PEK-ACI

We need to call the function. The user might want the request details. We can provide the HTTP method, URL, headers maybe. But the function only returns something. We can call the function.

{
  "url": "https://192.168.11.33/sedgeapi/v1/cisco-nir/api/api/telemetry/flowrules/nodes?fabricName=PEK-ACI",
  "fabricName": "PEK-ACI"
}

But the function expects fabricName to replace placeholder. We can just pass fabricName and let the function build URL? The function description says: The URL should include the target IP, API endpoint, and the fabricName query parameter placeholder https://<ip>/sedgeapi/v1/cisco-nir/api/api/telemetry/flowrules/nodes?fabricName={fabricName}. So we can pass fabricName and the function will replace placeholder. But we can also pass full URL. Let's pass both.
